limitations: Displayed metric values are rounded report values, not independently verified minima. Source ordinary via annulus .125 mm and minimum track .127 mm can display .12/.13 mm.
Detail tables retain at most 50 lowest-level results per layer/check; the displayed counts are not exhaustive totals. Main pad-spacing notices explicitly show 150 front and 209 back actual results.
Only F/B copper detail layer lists were observed despite six-layer detection; inner-layer check coverage is unverified.
No site XY, component reference or net localization was recovered. Gerber primitive dimensions do not independently establish a native design violation.
Main source nominal thickness is 1.600 mm; saved copper/dielectric sum is 1.6168 mm. No factory stack was selected or accepted.
Child has a through-hole header; its CPL is not approval for ordinary SMT assembly.
No geometry, rules, process parameters, source files, order or quote were changed.
Both automatic SMT analyses returned results. No completed PDF download is confirmed; both reports were retained as rendered page text.
The cloud browser reported it cannot render 3D models. 2D placement preview remained placeholders under Generating PCB. Orientation and model-to-Gerber overlays could not be visually validated.
No SMT threshold edits were made. Displayed numeric legends are rounded; raw SMT thresholds were not exposed.
Bottom SMT per-component identities could not be retrieved because the loading overlay intercepted layer selection.
privacy: This summary excludes account email, order/pricing data, and private upload/session IDs. Raw DOM snapshots are retained privately; inspect artifacts before any public publication.
